repos.description: Your lightweight open-source personal agent.
repos.summary_zh: nanobot 是 HKUDS 开发的开源超轻量级 AI 智能体，核心设计精简且可读。它支持聊天通道、记忆管理和 MCP 协议，可无缝集成工具与工作流。内置 WebUI，提供跨轮次目标追踪和图像生成能力，支持多模型 fallback。从本地快速部署到长期运行的个性化智能体，适用于自动化任务和智能助手场景。
repos.summary_en: nanobot is an open-source, ultra-lightweight AI agent developed by HKUDS, featuring a minimalist and readable core design. It supports chat channels, memory management, and the MCP protocol for seamless tool and workflow integration. With a built-in WebUI, it offers cross-turn goal tracking and end-to-end image generation, along with multi-model fallback support. Designed for easy deployment from local setups to long-running personal agents, it is ideal for automation tasks and intelligent assistant applications.

repos.description: Your Personal AI Assistant; easy to install, deploy on your own machine or on the cloud; supports multiple chat apps with easily extensible capabilities.
repos.summary_zh: QwenPaw是自主可控的个人AI助手，支持本地或云端部署确保数据隐私。提供日程管理、PDF/Office文档处理、新闻摘要等内置技能，支持自定义扩展。具备多智能体协作能力，可创建独立代理处理不同任务。跨平台连接多种聊天应用，技能决定功能边界，无供应商锁定风险。
repos.summary_en: QwenPaw is a personal AI assistant under your control, deployable locally or in the cloud to ensure data privacy. It features built-in skills including scheduling, PDF/Office document processing, and news digests, with support for custom extensions. Enables multi-agent collaboration by creating independent agents for different tasks. Connects across multiple chat platforms with extensible capabilities and no vendor lock-in.

repos.description: Huly — All-in-One Project Management Platform (alternative to Linear, Jira, Slack, Notion, Motion)
repos.summary_zh: Huly Platform 是开源一体化项目管理平台，替代 Jira、Linear 等工具。提供 Chat、CRM、HRM、ATS 等模块化应用，支持自托管与 API 驱动开发。基于 Node.js 全栈框架，采用 Docker 容器化部署，加速企业级业务应用构建，实现多团队协作与流程自动化。
repos.summary_en: Huly Platform is an open-source all-in-one project management solution that replaces Jira, Linear, Slack, and Notion. It provides modular applications including Chat, CRM, HRM, and ATS with self-hosting capability. Built on a Node.js full-stack framework using Docker containerization, it accelerates enterprise business application development through API-driven integration and automated workflows for team collaboration.

repos.description: SimpleX - the first messaging network operating without user identifiers of any kind - 100% private by design! iOS, Android and desktop apps 📱!
repos.summary_zh: SimpleX Chat是首个无任何用户标识符的消息平台，100%隐私设计，保护消息内容及元数据（通话对象与时间）。采用SMP协议通过单向匿名队列实现去中心化通信，支持用户自建服务器。具备双棘轮E2EE加密、多层防护、带外密钥交换、群组通话等功能。提供iOS、Android、桌面及CLI跨平台应用，适用于隐私敏感用户防范监控与垃圾信息场景。技术亮点包括便携加密存储和Tor支持。
repos.summary_en: SimpleX is the first messaging network operating without any user identifiers whatsoever, providing 100% privacy by design through protection of both message content and metadata. Built on the SimpleX Messaging Protocol (SMP), it uses unidirectional queues with pairwise anonymous addresses for decentralized, server-relayed communication where anyone can host servers. It features double-ratchet end-to-end encryption augmented with additional layers, out-of-band key exchange via links or QR codes, support for encrypted groups, calls, files, and optional Tor access. Cross-platform apps for iOS, Android, desktop, and terminal CLI enable portable encrypted data storage. Ideal for users prioritizing metadata privacy and spam resistance in secure communications.

repos.description: Let Claude Code, Codex or Cursor use your real Chrome, logged in as you. One prompt to set up. Open source, MIT.
repos.summary_zh: Browser Harness 是一个自愈式浏览器控制框架，通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 直连真实浏览器，让 LLM 自主完成任意网页任务。其核心创新在于动态生成缺失的辅助代码并持续学习优化，每次运行都自我改进。提供可复用的领域技能系统，支持从 LinkedIn 营销到电商下单等复杂自动化场景，架构精简仅千行代码。
repos.summary_en: Browser Harness is a self-healing browser automation framework that connects LLMs directly to real browsers via Chrome DevTools Protocol. Its core innovation lies in dynamically generating missing helper code during execution and continuously learning from each run. The framework features a reusable domain skills system for complex tasks like LinkedIn outreach and e-commerce ordering. With a minimal architecture of ~1k lines, it enables autonomous web task completion without predefined scripts, representing a new paradigm in LLM-driven browser automation.

repos.description: 📡 Your own AI-powered news radar. Generates daily briefings in English & Chinese. | 用 AI 构建你专属的新闻雷达
repos.summary_zh: AI驱动的新闻聚合雷达，自动抓取Hacker News、Reddit、RSS等多源资讯，通过Claude/GPT等模型进行去重、评分与摘要，生成个性化双语日报。支持自定义源、阈值与Feishu/邮件推送，保留人工筛选层，高效过滤信息噪音。
repos.summary_en: Horizon is an AI-powered news radar that automatically aggregates content from Hacker News, Reddit, RSS, Telegram, Twitter/X, and GitHub releases. It uses Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, or Ollama models to deduplicate, score (0-10), summarize, and enrich stories with background context and community discussions. The tool generates personalized bilingual daily briefings delivered via Feishu, email, or web, featuring customizable sources, thresholds, and human-in-the-loop curation to filter noise while preserving trusted content.

repos.description: MaiSaka, an LLM-based intelligent agent, is a digital lifeform devoted to understanding you and interacting in the style of a real human. She does not pursue perfection, nor does she seek efficiency; instead, she values warmth, authenticity, and genuine connection.
repos.summary_zh: 麦麦MaiBot是基于大语言模型的交互式智能体，定位为数字生命，致力于以真实人类风格互动，追求温暖、真实与连接而非完美或效率。核心亮点包括自然闲聊风格、群聊氛围感知与风格模仿、基于人格理论的用户画像积累，以及强大插件扩展系统。适用于个性化陪伴、智能对话和群聊参与等场景，提供更人性化的AI体验。
repos.summary_en: MaiBot (MaiSaka) is an LLM-powered interactive agent designed as a digital lifeform that engages in authentic human-like interactions, prioritizing warmth, authenticity, and genuine connection over perfection or efficiency. Key highlights include natural conversational styles, reading the room in group chats while mimicking styles and learning slang, building user profiles via personality theory, and a robust plugin system for extensibility. Ideal for personal companionship, immersive group conversations, and customizable AI experiences.

repos.description: A script allowing you to download images and videos from Telegram web even if the group restricts downloading.
repos.summary_zh: 该脚本是一款Telegram网页端用户脚本，可突破群组下载限制，实现图片、视频、GIF及音频等媒体的无损下载。支持私聊、频道及故事内容，通过注入页面解锁下载按钮，兼容主流浏览器及脚本管理器。无需后端服务，适用于需备份Telegram受限媒体资源的用户。
repos.summary_en: This user script bypasses Telegram web's download restrictions to save images, videos, GIFs, and audios from chats, stories, and private channels. It injects into pages to unlock download buttons, compatible with major browsers via script managers like Tampermonkey. Lightweight and backend-free, it efficiently backs up restricted Telegram media content.

repos.description: Collection great groups, channels, bots and libraries for Telegram
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个精选的Telegram资源聚合仓库，系统整理了官方与社区开发的优质机器人、群组、频道及开发库。涵盖新闻资讯、群组管理、财务记账、语音转译、PDF处理等多元化场景，提供从功能工具到社区运营的完整生态索引，是Telegram用户发现服务和开发者寻找灵感的核心枢纽。
repos.summary_en: A curated repository aggregating premium Telegram resources including bots, groups, channels, and development libraries. Features diverse applications spanning news delivery, community moderation, financial tracking, speech translation, and PDF processing. Provides a comprehensive ecosystem index for both end-users seeking utility services and developers exploring bot development opportunities on the Telegram platform, serving as a central discovery hub.

repos.description: Open-source, desktop-grade AI agent that gets real work done — data analysis, slides, docs, video & web research. Built on OpenClaw; runs tools on your real desktop and takes commands from your phone via WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk & Telegram.
repos.summary_zh: 网易有道推出的LobsterAI是一款24/7全场景AI个人助理，基于Electron+React构建跨平台桌面应用。核心采用Cowork模式，支持本地或Alpine沙盒环境执行任务，内置Office文档生成、Playwright自动化、Remotion视频生成等技能。通过Telegram/Discord/DingTalk/Feishu实现移动端远程控制，具备持久化记忆与权限审批机制，覆盖数据分析、PPT制作、邮件处理等办公场景。
repos.summary_en: LobsterAI by NetEase Youdao is a 24/7 all-scenario AI personal assistant built on Electron+React. Its core Cowork mode executes tasks in local or Alpine sandbox environments, featuring built-in skills like Office document generation, Playwright automation, and Remotion video creation. It enables remote control via IM platforms (Telegram/Discord/DingTalk/Feishu), persistent memory, permission gating, and covers productivity scenarios including data analysis, presentation creation, and email management.

repos.description: Turn your Telegram account into an unlimited, secure cloud storage drive. an Open-source desktop app built with Tauri, Rust, and React.
repos.summary_zh: Telegram Drive是一款开源跨平台桌面应用，利用Telegram API将账号转化为无限安全的云存储驱动。基于Tauri、Rust和React构建，提供熟悉的文件资源管理器界面，支持Saved Messages和Channels作为文件夹。核心亮点包括高性能虚拟滚动、媒体流式播放、内置PDF查看器、拖放上传、密码保护分享链接、本地REST API支持AI集成、代理及VPN优化。隐私优先，数据与密钥本地存储，无第三方服务器。兼容Windows、macOS、Linux及Android平台。
repos.summary_en: Telegram Drive is an open-source cross-platform desktop app that turns your Telegram account into unlimited, secure cloud storage. Built with Tauri, Rust, and React, it provides a familiar file explorer using Saved Messages and Channels as folders. Highlights include high-performance virtual scrolling, media streaming, built-in PDF viewer, drag-and-drop, password-protected shareable links, local REST API for AI integration, proxy/VPN optimization, and privacy focus with all data local and no third-party servers. Supports Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android.

repos.description: 📃 A better UX for chat, writing content, and coding with LLMs.
repos.summary_zh: Open Canvas 是 LangChain 开源的 AI 文档协作平台，基于 LangGraph 构建多智能体系统。核心亮点包括：内置反思智能体实现跨会话记忆，支持从现有文档开始而非强制聊天，提供可定制快捷操作和版本回溯，同时支持代码与 Markdown 实时渲染编辑。作为 OpenAI Canvas 的开源替代方案，它通过持久化用户风格规则实现个性化体验，适用于写作、编程等场景。
repos.summary_en: Open Canvas is LangChain's open-source AI document collaboration platform built on LangGraph multi-agent architecture. Key innovations include: built-in reflection agents with cross-session memory, starting from existing documents instead of chat-only, customizable quick actions, artifact versioning, and live code/Markdown editing. As an open alternative to OpenAI Canvas, it personalizes experiences by persisting user style rules and insights, ideal for writing, coding, and collaborative content creation.

repos.description: Image Hosting solution, Flickr/imgur alternative, make it easy for users to share their images. Using Cloudflare Pages and Telegraph.
repos.summary_zh: Telegraph-Image 是基于 Cloudflare Pages 和 Telegram Channel 的免费图床方案，替代 Flickr/imgur。核心价值：无限存储（单图5MB限制）、零服务器成本、自动绑定 pages.dev 域名或自定义域名。技术亮点包括可选 AI 图片审查、后台管理（网格/瀑布流视图）、批量删除与分页功能，完全依赖 Cloudflare 免费额度运营。
repos.summary_en: Telegraph-Image is a free image hosting solution using Cloudflare Pages and Telegram Channel as a Flickr/imgur alternative. Key value: unlimited storage (5MB/image cap), zero server cost, automatic *.pages.dev domain or custom domain binding. Technical highlights include optional AI image moderation, backend management (grid/waterfall views), batch operations, and full operation within Cloudflare's free tier limits.

repos.description: A calm, open system for organizing life and work. Tasks, projects, notes, areas, and smart workflows - self-hosted or hosted.
repos.summary_zh: tududi是一款自托管任务管理工具，融合个人简洁性与专业项目组织能力。核心亮点包括智能递归任务系统（支持多种模式、完成触发机制）、Telegram集成、多层级结构（领域-项目-任务-子任务），以及24种语言支持。面向注重隐私与效率的个人及团队，提供开放API与响应式设计，实现数据自主可控的生产力提升。
repos.summary_en: tududi is a self-hosted task management tool that merges personal simplicity with professional project organization. Its core features include an intelligent recurring task system with multiple patterns and completion-based triggers, seamless Telegram integration, and a hierarchical structure (Areas > Projects > Tasks > Subtasks). Designed for privacy-conscious individuals and teams, it offers 24-language support, OpenAPI documentation, and responsive design for full data control and productivity across devices.

repos.description: 🌩️ Serverless 自托管的文件管理与文本分享工具/网盘，支持多存储聚合管理和WebDAV 服务挂载。兼容 S3、WebDAV、OneDrive、Google Drive、Telegram、HF、GitHub 等。内置   Markdown 编辑器、30+文件格式预览。支持 Cloudflare Workers 或 Docker 部署。
repos.summary_zh: CloudPaste 是一款基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Serverless 自托管网盘，核心价值在于多云存储聚合管理与零运维部署。支持 S3、OneDrive、Google Drive 等 30+ 存储后端，提供统一 WebDAV 挂载。内置 Vditor Markdown 编辑器与 30+ 文件格式预览，实现个人知识库管理与团队协作。通过边缘计算实现全球加速，Docker 部署提供本地灵活性。
repos.summary_en: CloudPaste is a Serverless self-hosted cloud storage built on Cloudflare Workers, aggregating 30+ storage backends including S3, OneDrive, and Google Drive with unified WebDAV mounting. It features a Vditor Markdown editor, 30+ file format previews, and edge computing acceleration across 300+ global nodes. Offering zero-maintenance deployment via Workers or Docker, it serves as an ideal solution for personal knowledge management and team collaboration.

repos.description: Turn your Telegram Channel into a MicroBlog.
repos.summary_zh: BroadcastChannel 是一个基于 Astro 的工具，可将 Telegram 频道转化为轻量级微型博客。它无需浏览器端 JavaScript，提供 SEO 友好的站点地图和 RSS 订阅，支持 Cloudflare、Vercel 等无服务器部署。用户只需配置频道用户名，即可快速搭建独立博客，实现内容同步与自定义域名绑定。
repos.summary_en: BroadcastChannel transforms your Telegram channel into a lightweight microblog using Astro. It requires zero client-side JavaScript, delivers SEO-friendly sitemaps and RSS feeds, and supports deployment on serverless platforms like Cloudflare and Vercel. Simply configure your channel username to launch a standalone blog with custom domain support.

repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Pages 和 Next.js 的 Serverless 图床服务。利用 Cloudflare 免费额度实现无限存储且零成本运营，无需自备服务器和域名。集成内容审核 API 自动屏蔽不良图片，提供完整的后台管理系统，支持访问统计、黑白名单管控，并可配置 Telegram 机器人实时通知。
repos.summary_en: A Serverless image hosting service built on Cloudflare Pages and Next.js. Offers unlimited storage at zero cost within Cloudflare's free tier, eliminating the need for self-hosted servers and domains. Features automated content moderation API for inappropriate images, a full-featured admin panel with access analytics, IP/referer whitelisting/blacklisting, and configurable Telegram bot notifications.

repos.description: 一个基于 NextJS + Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱消息推送服务, 支持多种消息推送渠道✨
repos.summary_zh: MoePush 是基于 Next.js 与 Cloudflare 全栈构建的开源消息推送服务，支持钉钉、企业微信、Telegram 等十余种渠道。项目采用边缘计算架构，通过 Cloudflare Pages 与 D1 数据库实现零成本部署，提供接口组批量推送能力。UI 基于 shadcn/ui 打造，兼具美观与易用性，适用于监控告警、自动化通知等场景。
repos.summary_en: MoePush is an open-source, adorable message push service built on Next.js and Cloudflare stack, supporting over 10 channels including DingTalk, WeCom, Telegram, and more. Leveraging edge computing architecture with Cloudflare Pages and D1 database, it enables zero-cost deployment and batch push via group interfaces. The UI, crafted with shadcn/ui, combines aesthetics with usability. Ideal for monitoring alerts and automated notifications, it offers a developer-friendly solution with GitHub OAuth integration and seamless deployment.

repos.description: Vocat is an open-source web control panel and engineering toolkit for Quectel EC20/EC25-class cellular modems. It combines modem discovery, live radio status, AT and USSD terminals, SMS, WiFi Calling, eSIM management, network selection, proxy routing, notifications, audit logs, and release automation in one self-contained service.
repos.summary_zh: Vocat 是开源的移远 EC20/EC25 蜂窝模组 Web 管理面板，集成模组发现、射频监控、AT/USSD 终端、短信、WiFi Calling、eSIM 管理、网络选择与代理路由，Go+React 单二进制部署，支持多架构 Docker。
repos.summary_en: Vocat is an open-source web control panel for Quectel EC20/EC25 cellular modems, integrating modem discovery, radio monitoring, AT/USSD terminals, SMS, WiFi Calling, eSIM management, network selection, and proxy routing. Built with Go and React, it deploys as a single binary with multi-arch Docker support.

repos.description: 使用Telegram作为存储的文件外链系统，不限制文件大小和格式。
repos.summary_zh: tgState 是一款创新的文件外链系统，深度利用 Telegram 的 Bot API 和 FileID 机制，将 Telegram 频道/群组作为无限容量存储后端。系统支持任意大小格式的文件存储分发，提供 Web 界面和 API 上传接口，可作为图床或私有网盘使用。支持 Docker、Vercel 等多种部署方式，配合 CloudFlare 可实现高效 CDN 加速。
repos.summary_en: tgState is an innovative file hosting system that leverages Telegram's Bot API and FileID mechanism to utilize Telegram channels/groups as unlimited-capacity storage backend. Supporting files of any size and format, it provides both web interface and API for uploads, functioning as image hosting or private cloud storage. Features flexible deployment via Docker, Vercel, or binary, with CloudFlare CDN integration for optimized content delivery.

repos.description: 【零费用】一个让人呼吸顺畅的 Telegram 双向私聊机器人 🤖 / [Zero Cost] A Smooth-Operating Two-Way Private Messaging Telegram Bot 🤖
repos.summary_zh: Open Wegram Bot 是基于 Cloudflare Worker/Vercel 的 Telegram 双向私聊机器人，实现零成本、无服务器、无数据库的消息中转。采用无状态架构，支持 GitHub/Vercel 等多平台一键部署，无需绑定域名即可运行。适用于个人消息代理、轻量级客服等场景，提供稳定可靠的双向通信能力，是 LivegramBot 的免费替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Open Wegram Bot is a Telegram two-way private messaging bot built on Cloudflare Worker/Vercel, enabling zero-cost, serverless, database-free message forwarding. Featuring stateless architecture, it supports one-click deployment via GitHub/Vercel/Deno/Netlify without custom domain binding. Designed for personal message proxy and lightweight customer service, it provides stable bidirectional communication as a free alternative to LivegramBot with multi-bot support and encrypted security tokens for reliable operation.

repos.description: 🔒True end-to-end encrypted (E2EE) chat system in web. 🔒真正的网页端到端加密聊天系统
repos.summary_zh: NodeCrypt 是一个基于 Web 的真正端到端加密聊天系统，采用零知识架构确保服务器无法获取明文消息。系统使用三层安全体系：RSA-2048 身份验证、ECDH-P384 密钥协商和混合对称加密（AES-256 + ChaCha20）。基于 Cloudflare Workers 部署，无需数据库，支持匿名聊天和前向安全性，所有加密在客户端完成。
repos.summary_en: NodeCrypt is a true end-to-end encrypted web chat system implementing zero-knowledge architecture where servers cannot access plaintext messages. It employs a three-layer security model: RSA-2048 for server authentication, ECDH-P384 for key negotiation, and hybrid symmetric encryption (AES-256-CBC for control messages, ChaCha20 for chat content). Built on Cloudflare Workers with Durable Objects and WebSocket, the system requires no database storage, supports anonymous communication, and provides forward secrecy. All encryption occurs client-side using Web Cryptography API, with room passwords as key derivation factors. The open-source implementation is verifiable through browser developer tools and network traffic analysis.

repos.description: Self-hosted SIM/eSIM gateway for VoWiFi calling, SMS, cellular data and isolated regional egress
repos.summary_zh: MDD Sim Gateway 是面向 Debian/Ubuntu/Armbian ARM64 的自托管多 SIM/eSIM 通信网关。它整合蜂窝模块、USB 读卡器、IMS、EAP-AKA、ModemManager 与 sing-box，通过中英文 Web 控制台实现真实 SIM 鉴权（不读取 Ki/OP）、浏览器软电话通话与短信、多模块统一管理及独立国家出口 TUN，UDP 失败时不泄漏。适用于自建 VoWiFi、隔离区域网络出口与运营商线路保号场景。
repos.summary_en: MDD Sim Gateway is a self-hosted multi-SIM/eSIM communication gateway for Debian/Ubuntu/Armbian ARM64. It integrates cellular modules, USB readers, IMS, EAP-AKA, ModemManager and sing-box into a bilingual web console, enabling real SIM authentication (no Ki/OP exposure), browser softphone calls/SMS, multi-module management and isolated country egress TUNs that never leak on UDP failure. Ideal for self-hosted VoWiFi, regional network isolation and carrier line keepalive.

repos.description: DeepSeek 逆向 API
repos.summary_zh: DeepSeek2API通过逆向工程将DeepSeek模型封装为OpenAI兼容接口，支持deepseek-chat、deepseek-reasoner等模型。核心特性包括高速流式输出、多轮对话、R1深度思考及多账号轮换机制，有效分散单账号风险。提供Docker、Vercel及原生部署方案，配置灵活。项目明确声明仅限研究学习使用，禁止商用，规避官方服务压力与封号风险。
repos.summary_en: DeepSeek2API wraps DeepSeek models into OpenAI-compatible interfaces via reverse engineering, supporting deepseek-chat, deepseek-reasoner and search variants. Key features include high-speed streaming output, multi-turn conversation, R1 deep reasoning, and multi-account rotation to mitigate single-account limitations. Offers flexible deployment via Docker, Vercel, or native Python. Project explicitly for research/learning only, prohibiting commercial use to avoid official service pressure and account bans.

repos.description: TypeScript SDK for the NitroPing audit log — batching client, error capture, Hono/Express/Nitro adapters, and GenAI cost tracing.
repos.summary_zh: nitroping-sdk 是 nitroping.dev 平台的官方多语言客户端库，支持 TypeScript、Swift、Python、Go、Kotlin、PHP 等语言，封装 REST API 实现设备令牌注册（APNs/FCM/Web Push）、多渠道通知发送（推送、邮件、SMS、Slack）、定向/定时/循环推送、Web Push 订阅与 UI 组件、内置收件箱及 Webhook 验证。适用于移动/Web 应用与服务器端通知集成，提供统一 API、公私钥认证和幂等性支持，实现跨平台一致体验。
repos.summary_en: nitroping-sdk offers official client libraries for the nitroping.dev platform across TypeScript, Swift, Python, Go, Kotlin, and PHP. It wraps the REST API for device token registration (APNs/FCM/Web Push), multi-channel notifications (push, email, SMS, Slack), targeted/scheduled/recurring sends, Web Push subscriptions with UI widgets, in-app inbox, and webhook verification. Ideal for mobile/web apps and servers needing unified, secure cross-platform notification delivery with public/secret key auth and idempotency.
